journal.empty: Nothing here yet. Your first flight fills this page.

journey.title: Your route

profile.departureLocked: Your journey started in {city}. The departure can't change once you've flown.
profile.dataBody: Everything is stored only on this device. Save a backup file before switching phones or clearing browser data.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen: it opens full-screen, works offline and can show your flight on the lock screen.
pwa.iosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.installed: Installed. You're using the app version.
pwa.offline: Offline · your progress is saved on this device
pwa.iosKeep: In Safari, install to your home screen so your travel log is kept safely: Share → Add to Home Screen.

companion.cabinHint: Plays a soft cabin hum, which puts a flight card with your destination and landing time on the lock screen — you can pause from there too.
companion.notifyHint: Shows your landing time while you focus, and tells you when you land.
companion.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or system settings.
companion.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work after installing the app to your home screen.
companion.title: Flying to {city}
companion.arrivedBody: A new postcard is waiting for you.
companion.lockTitle: Show the flight on the lock screen

welcome.lead: Focus, and you fly between real cities. Every arrival leaves you a postcard.
welcome.how1: Each focused minute flies you {km} km. Pause anytime.
welcome.how2: Land in a real city and collect its pixel-art postcard.
welcome.how3: Every flight stays in Postcards and on the map. Days off are fine.
welcome.private: No sign-up. Everything stays on this device.
welcome.fromBody: Your home airport. You can start over later in Settings.
welcome.toBody: Flight time = focus time. A short first flight gets you your first postcard sooner.
welcome.laterAnywhere: After this, you can fly to any of the 50 cities.
welcome.boardBody: {minutes} minutes of focus takes you to {city}.
welcome.nSessions: About {n} sessions of {minutes} minutes get you there — progress carries over.
welcome.awayOk: You can leave the app or lock the screen — time keeps counting.
welcome.landsInOne: This flight lands in {time} — the session ends as you land.

notFound.title: This page flew off the map
notFound.body: The address may be wrong. Your travel log is safe.

note.carried: Carried over from your last flight

flight.nonstopBody: Flown start to finish without a pause.

firstTrip.nextHint: Tap a suggested city to fly on, or search for any city.
